Andy Cinquin publishes Minemories and is: Andy Cinquin publishes Minemories and is responsible for the personal data it handles. Send any question or request about your data through the legal notice page.

Minemories counts visits with Umami, an: Minemories counts visits with Umami, an open-source tool the publisher hosts at Contabo, in Germany. No other company sees these statistics. It sets no cookie and shows no ads. It records the page, the site you came from, your browser, your country, page speed and page errors. Share links and public links are never recorded in full. When you are signed in, visits are tied to a code made from your account, never to your name or email. Your IP address gives the country and is not kept. The switch below turns it off on this device, as does your browser’s Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control.
